> SDAssist Aether is the world's first AI-powered SAP S/4HANA Digital Twin — an intelligent configuration platform for SAP Sales & Distribution (SD), Materials Management (MM), and Financial Accounting & Controlling (FICO).

## What is SDAssist Aether?

SDAssist Aether (sd-assist.vercel.app) is a neural-OS web application designed for SAP consultants, functional architects, enterprise teams, and students learning SAP. It leverages the Llama 3.3 large language model (via Groq) to generate precise, audit-ready SAP configuration roadmaps in seconds.

## Core Capabilities

- **SAP SD Neural Architect**: Generate T-Code configuration paths for Sales Organization setup (OX02, OVX5), pricing procedures (V/08), Order-to-Cash cycles, and partner function mapping.
- **Neural Pricing Lab**: High-fidelity SPRO Control Data grid simulation using the SAP Condition Technique (Specific → General hierarchy with Access Sequences).
- **Order-to-Cash (O2C) Visualizer**: Interactive mapping of the VA11 → VA21 → VA01 → VL01N → VF01 lifecycle.
- **Enterprise Topology**: Assignment matrix for Sales Org, Distribution Channel, Division, Company Code, and Plant relationships.
- **MM-Link Console**: Procure-to-Pay visualization: ME51N → ME21N → MIGO → MIRO.
- **FICO-Sync Ledger**: Automated G/L account determination via VKOA with Billing-to-Finance integration.
- **Vision Neural Lab**: Upload SAP GUI screenshots to detect configuration glitches via AI spatial analysis.
- **Master Data Dossier**: Multi-tier Customer & Material Master views (General, Company Code, Sales Area).
- **Google Workspace Integration**: OAuth2-secured sync to Google Sheets, Docs, and Calendar.
- **Overseer Safety Layer**: Neural T-Code validation and configuration loop detection.

## Technology Stack

- Frontend: React 18, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion
- AI Engine: Llama 3.3-70B-Versatile via Groq API
- Auth/Sync: Google OAuth2, Google Sheets API v4, Google Calendar API, Google Docs API v1
- Deployment: Vercel (Edge Network)
- Repository: https://github.com/harshshukla2016/SDAssist-The-Intelligent-S-4HANA-Configuration-Agent

## Target Audience

SAP SD consultants, SAP functional consultants, S/4HANA architects, ERP students, enterprise configuration teams, and organizations migrating from SAP ECC to S/4HANA.

## Key SAP Keywords & Topics Covered

SAP SD, SAP Sales Distribution, S/4HANA configuration, SAP pricing procedure, condition technique, access sequence, Order-to-Cash, O2C, VA01, VF01, VL01N, ME21N, MIGO, MIRO, VKOA, OX02, OVX5, SAP enterprise structure, SAP MM, SAP FICO, SAP FI, SAP CO, G/L account, Accounts Receivable, chart of accounts, SAP master data, customer master, material master, SAP ERP, SAP consultant tool, AI ERP assistant, intelligent SAP configuration.
